subject.title: startup migrations: unreadable file in one plugin dir (EACCES) is classified as "migrations did not complete cleanly" and blocks the whole gateway

question: Should an unreadable plugin package block gateway readiness only when that plugin is configured or required, or should every discovered plugin remain fail-closed?
rationale: The classification and repair guidance are clearly defective, but changing the fatality boundary trades upgrade availability against silent loss of configured channel behavior.

options.title: Gate configured plugins only
options.body: Fail readiness for configured or required plugins, but quarantine unused unreadable plugins and start with a prominent actionable warning.

options.title: Keep universal fail-closed
options.body: Continue blocking on every discovered plugin, but report a plugin permission failure directly and replace the ineffective repair guidance.

options.title: Always disable and continue
options.body: Boot despite any plugin payload failure, accepting that configured channel behavior could disappear until an operator notices the warning.

recommendation.title: Gate configured plugins only
recommendation.body: Fail readiness for configured or required plugins, but quarantine unused unreadable plugins and start with a prominent actionable warning.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history ties this person to the convergence repair and startup migration behavior that now owns this decision.
